A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the energy-linked reaction of succinate, dl-α-glycerophosphate, d-lactate, and NAD+ in membranes derived from aerobically cultured E. coli is mediated by the ubiquinone-cytochrome b-c1 complex and that the reaction can be demonstrated in membranes from a variety of respiratory-deficient mutant E. coli only after reconstitution of the missing dehydrogenase or cytochrome.
